installCommand: if [ -f "package.json" ] && grep -q "rag-chatbot-frontend" package.json; then npm install && chmod +x node_modules/.bin/* || true; else npm --prefix frontend install && chmod +x frontend/node_modules/.bin/* || true; fi
buildCommand: if [ -f "package.json" ] && grep -q "rag-chatbot-frontend" package.json; then npx vite build; else npm --prefix frontend run build; fi
